evidence: Vulg. Is. 37.38: fūgēruntque in terram Ararat
terms.comment: The Hebrew name, which the Vulgate keeps undeclined for the land; Lewis & Short lacks it. Where the ark comes to rest (Gen. 8.4) the Vulgate does not use it: see the next term.

terms.gloss: the mountains of Armenia, where the ark rested
evidence: Vulg. Gen. 8.4: requiēvitque arca … super montēs Armeniae
terms.comment: The Vulgate’s rendering of the mountains of Ararat. Armenia has a short e (Lewis & Short).

sources: The Vulgate, read in the Latin Library text (thelatinlibrary.com), cited by book, chapter and verse.
